Hi Alex 	6

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a formal quote for FintechCos private VPC deployment: 

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: document understanding and transactional summarization inside customer support/ops workflows.
- Preferred deployment: Private (VPC) with data residency in us-west.
- Desired SLOs: <100ms P50 for short prompts; tolerance for higher tail on long-RAG runs.

Immediate asks for pricing/qualification (can reply inline):
1) Estimated monthly token consumption (approx.): monthly tokens ingested + generated  ballpark is fine (e.g., 10M / 50M / 250M tokens).
2) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range we should optimize toward?
3) Environments: how many environments do you want Redwood to provision? (prod / staging / qa / dev  count and approximate user concurrency).
4) Support tier preference: Standard / Premium (24/7) / Enterprise (named support + SLA).

Well respond with two pricing options: (A) committed capacity (reserved GPU pools + discounted per-token) and (B) subscription licensing (platform fee + tiered token rate). If you share the items above Ill attach a tailored estimate and SLA options.

Ive put Marissa on copy  shell include support and SLA options in the follow-up.

Next steps: if you can reply with rough token volumes and budget by EOD today well prioritize a draft quote.

Thanks,
Ben

Alex 	6 thanks for the details, that helps a lot. High-level pricing frameworks well prepare for the quote (preview below):

Option A 	6 Committed Reserved Capacity (recommended if you expect steady growth to 50M+/mo)
- Annual commitment for a dedicated GPU pool (reserved instances).
- Effective per-1M token rate in the $160220 range depending on commit size and quantization profile.
- Includes platform licensing, control plane, telemetry, and KV/prefix caching optimizations.
- Overages billed per 1M tokens at a set rate.

Option B 	6 Subscription Licensing + Tiered Token Rate
- Annual platform subscription (flat fee covers control plane & management).
- Tiered per-token pricing: e.g., $300/1M up to 25M, $225/1M for 25100M, $180/1M above 100M.
- Better if you want predictable op-ex and lower upfront.

Support tiers (pricing ranges, ballpark)
- Standard: included, business hours support 	6 no named SLAs.
- Premium: +2030% on list pricing 	6 24/7 support, 1-hour P1 response.
- Enterprise: named TAM, quarterly reviews, prioritized roadmap, price on request.

Environments: We can provision 3 environments (prod/staging/qa) into the single VPC. Production cluster sizing is based on concurrency + peak prompt lengths 	6 for 15 concurrent sessions well recommend a 23 GPU reserved pool in the baseline quote (well size precisely after you share average prompt length and token budget distribution).

Unit economics example (illustrative for 50M/mo)
- Option A (committed): $180/1M * 50 = $9,000/month + platform fee amortized ($2k4k) => ~$11k3k/month.
- Option B (sub): blended ~ $225/1M * 50 = $11,250/month + subscription fee => ~$13k5k/month.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Marissa will attach SLA options & a preliminary pricing worksheet.
2) Well produce a formal quote + example SOW (to your procurement).
3) If the numbers look good, schedule a technical kick-off to validate infra/network needs and a timeline for VPC setup.

Im attaching a draft pricing worksheet and the high-level proposal for your review 	6 will follow with a formal PDF and an SOW template.

Thanks,
Ben
